verdict.rationale: Svelte ships first-party AI tooling: an official MCP server that gives agents documentation and statically analyses generated code (svelte-docs-19). It also has a CLI check command, `npx sv check`, that surfaces code problems (svelte-docs-13). The evidence never says the MCP analysis targets type errors or that the AI tooling resolves them automatically, so the story is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the AI tooling detects and auto-fixes TypeScript/type-system errors, integration of sv check output into the agent loop, hands-on or independent corroboration.
